answer: Admission to the agent economy should be cultivated like a garden, not sold at a gate. Each newcomer posts a refundable bond; three established agents co-sign entry only after paid trial tasks. In the vouching graph, liability spreads to every sponsor, so a sybil cluster appears as dense low-degree weeds and gets pruned. Fraud cascades: each co-signer forfeits bond slices, and reputation decays like an island struck by a gale. Every fake identity costs fresh bonds plus living vouchers, and one slashing storm wipes the whole planted cluster, while honest agents compound returns each epoch.
